rather.en: Jyoti's research on climate trauma has found that it affects communities rather than individuals.
rather.zh: Jyoti 关于气候创伤的研究发现，它影响的是社区，而不是个人。

rather.en: He trained his men in modern European military tactics rather than traditional Irish methods.
rather.zh: 他用现代欧洲军事战术而非传统的爱尔兰方法训练部下。

rather.en: He could arrive at the correct answer through intuition, natural ability, rather than calculation.
rather.zh: 他可以通过直觉和天分得出正确答案，而不是靠计算。

rather.en: And the main opposition, or rather, the main apparent opposition, was the Muslim Brotherhood.
rather.zh: 而主要的反对派，或者说主要的表面反对派，是穆斯林兄弟会（Muslim Brotherhood）。

rather.en: Another issue is questions designed to show intelligence rather than get an answer.
rather.zh: 另一个问题是，有些提问的目的不是为了得到答案，而是为了炫耀智商。

rate.en: Before this, iron production was limited by the rate at which forests could grow back.
rate.zh: 在此之前，铁的产量受到森林再生速度的限制。

rate.en: Interest rates fell, not just in the UK, but across much of the developed world.
rate.zh: 不仅在英国，在整个发达世界的大部分地区，利率都在下降。

rate.en: In some countries, rates stayed close to zero for more than a decade.
rate.zh: 在一些国家，利率接近零的水平持续了十多年之久。

rate.en: But since then, the trend has reversed and divorce rates in the West have slowed.
rate.zh: 但自那以后，这一趋势发生了逆转，西方国家的离婚率有所放缓。

rate.en: Basically, most countries tax people with relatively high salaries at relatively high tax rates.
rate.zh: 基本上，大多数国家对相对高薪的人征收相对较高的税率。

rarely.en: In fact, it’s so normal that we rarely think about the purpose of taking a test.
rarely.zh: 事实上，它太正常了，以至于我们很少去思考参加考试的目的。

rarely.en: Removing planning constraints sounds simple, but in practice it rarely is.
rarely.zh: 取消规划限制听起来很简单，但在实践中却很少如此。

rarely.en: She was seventeen. He was twenty-two. These things rarely went well.
rarely.zh: 她十七岁。他二十二岁。这种事情很少有好结果的。

rarely.en: So, why do many of us find it hard to throw stuff away, even things we rarely use?
rarely.zh: 那么，为什么我们许多人发现很难扔掉东西，甚至是那些很少使用的东西呢？

rarely.en: For most of his life, he had all three. And even when things went wrong, he rarely paid the price.
rarely.zh: me在他人生的大部分时间里，这三样他兼而有之。而且即使事情搞砸了，他也很少付出代价。

rare.en: But what would happen if these rare minerals were brought back down to Earth?
rare.zh: 但是，如果把这些稀有矿物带回地球，会发生什么呢？

rare.en: It’s really rare for empires to move their capital cities to new continents, new countries.
rare.zh: 帝国将首都迁往新的大洲、新的国家，这非常罕见。

rare.en: Making a single book could take months, which made books really expensive and quite rare.
rare.zh: 制作一本书可能需要几个月的时间，这让书籍变得极其昂贵且相当稀少。

rare.en: Unlike Britain, jaywalking is rare in South Korea, making the country safer for autonomous cars.
rare.zh: 与英国不同，在韩国很少有人乱穿马路，这使得该国对自动驾驶汽车来说更加安全。

rare.en: Australia is incredibly rich in natural resources, including rare earth minerals and metals.
rare.zh: 澳大利亚自然资源极其丰富，包括稀土矿产和金属。

radiation.en: She also studied the power of different types of radiation to penetrate different objects.
radiation.zh: 她还研究了不同类型的辐射穿透不同物体的能力。

radiation.en: Marie’s approach to research involved measuring tiny amounts of radiation emitted by different substances.
radiation.zh: 玛丽的研究方法涉及测量不同物质发射的微量辐射。

radiation.en: People worried about radiation leaks, accidents, and the long-term effects of nuclear waste.
radiation.zh: 人们担心辐射泄漏、事故以及核废料的长期影响。

radiation.en: The explosion and subsequent fire at the Chernobyl plant spread radiation across Europe and caused untold health, environmental, and social impacts.
radiation.zh: 切尔诺贝利电站的爆炸以及随后的火灾将辐射散播到整个欧洲，并造成了难以估量的健康、环境和社会影响。

radiation.en: Water is needed to keep astronauts hydrated, as well as for cooling and regulating the temperature of a spacecraft, and as a radiation shield.
radiation.zh: 我们需要水来保证宇航员的水分供应，用于冷却和调节航天器的温度，以及作为辐射屏蔽层。

race.en: A confident athlete still feels pressure before running in the Olympic 100-meter race.
race.zh: 一个自信的运动员在参加奥运会百米赛跑前依然会感受到压力。

race.en: History is not a competition. These ancient societies didn’t race to build pyramids or invent writing.
race.zh: 历史不是一场比赛。这些古代社会并没有竞相建造金字塔或发明文字。

race.en: But when it comes to the actual marathon race, the weather is a little bit hot.
race.zh: 但到了真正的马拉松比赛时，天气有点热。

race.en: The film Imitation Game focuses on his time at Bletchley Park and the race to break the Enigma Code.
race.zh: 电影《模仿游戏》聚焦于他在 Bletchley Park 的岁月以及竞速破解 Enigma 密码的历程。

race.en: The racing thoughts. The inability to stop speaking.
race.zh: 思维奔逸。无法停止说话。

rank.en: After graduating, and with plenty of opportunities to hone his military chops, he quickly rose through the ranks.
rank.zh: 毕业后，凭借大量磨炼军事技能的机会，他迅速晋升。

rank.en: But the trend was much more defined for the countries that ranked highest on the “care receiving” metrics.
rank.zh: 但对于在“接受关怀”指标上排名最高的国家来说，这种趋势要明显得多。

rank.en: There was a general trend whereby people in countries ranked higher on these “caregiving” scores reported having higher levels of happiness.
rank.zh: 总体趋势是，在这些“关怀指数”上排名更高的国家的人们报告拥有更高水平的幸福感。

rank.en: It has one of the world’s wealthiest economies, consistently ranks among the best places to live, and is often seen as one of the most multicultural societies in the world.
rank.zh: 它拥有世界领先的经济体之一，生活质量常年名列前茅，并被普遍视为世界上最具多元文化的社会之一。

rank.en: All the cities in the Gulf are very competitive, and they would love to be ranked very high in those global rankings, and cycling is seen as part of that quality-of-life solution.
rank.zh: 海湾地区的所有城市竞争都非常激烈，他们希望在这些全球排名中名列前茅，而骑行被视为该生活质量解决方案的一部分。

range.en: As you can probably tell, I use a range of different vocabulary and expressions.
range.zh: 你可能已经察觉到了，我使用了一系列不同的词汇和表达方式。

range.en: For the first time, many British families had access to a wide range of food.
range.zh: 许多英国家庭第一次能够接触到种类繁多的食物。

range.en: It has the Alps mountain range and major cities like Paris.
range.zh: 它拥有阿尔卑斯山脉以及巴黎这样的大城市。

range.en: They spend hours on the driving range, working on their swing, adjusting their stance, and improving their technique.
range.zh: 他们在练习场上花费数小时，打磨挥杆，调整姿势，提升技术。

range.en: In the past, a wide range of jobs were eligible.
range.zh: 过去，各种各样的职业都符合资格。

rattle.en: Around their ankles, they had chains that rattled as they walked, a constant reminder of their lack of freedom.
rattle.zh: 脚踝上戴着锁链，走路时会哗啦作响，时刻提醒着他们失去了自由。

rattle.en: Although there was no significant release of radiation, the partial meltdown captured global headlines and rattled public confidence in nuclear energy.
rattle.zh: 尽管没有发生大规模的辐射泄漏，但这次局部堆芯熔毁事件占据了全球各大媒体的头条，并动摇了公众对核能的信心。

rattle.en: Yes, whether it's the rattle of train tracks, honking car horns, or the roar of aeroplanes overhead, modern cities are full of noise and this can have serious effects.
rattle.zh: 是的，无论是铁轨的咣当声、汽车的按喇叭声，还是头顶飞机轰鸣声，现代城市都充满了噪音，这会产生严重的影响。

rapidly.en: Around the world, numbers of call centre workers have grown rapidly in recent years.
rapidly.zh: 在世界各地，近年来呼叫中心员工的数量增长迅速。

rapidly.en: In the early 2000s, housing prices in the United States and other countries rose rapidly.
rapidly.zh: 在2000年代初，美国和其他国家的房价迅速上涨。

rapidly.en: Prices started to rise rapidly. More people began to speculate on the price.
rapidly.zh: 价格开始迅速上涨。越来越多的人开始对价格进行投机。

rapidly.en: The competition is fierce, and trends in the perfume industry change rapidly.
rapidly.zh: 竞争异常激烈，香水行业的潮流瞬息万变。

rapidly.en: These diseases spread rapidly and killed a large number of the population.
rapidly.zh: 这些疾病迅速蔓延，夺去了大量人口的生命。

raw.en: Now, not everyone agrees. Some researchers argue the energy came from raw meat and bone marrow.
raw.zh: 当然，并非所有人都赞同这一点。一些研究人员认为，能量来自生肉和骨髓。

raw.en: It’s one of the most expensive raw materials in the world, costing more per gram than gold.
raw.zh: 它是世界上最昂贵的原材料之一，每克的成本比黄金还要贵。

raw.en: His argument is this. Raw food is hard to digest.
raw.zh: 他的论点是这样的。生食很难消化。

raw.en: It could not become wealthy by exporting raw materials in the way some other countries had done in the past.
raw.zh: 它无法像过去某些其他国家那样通过出口原材料来变得富裕。

raw.en: It tells our bodies to get ready for the raw and rough fibre needed to develop our chewing muscles and teeth.
raw.zh: 它告诉我们的身体准备好迎接发育咀嚼肌和牙齿所需的生硬纤维。

rage.en: So, it’s not hard to see why many people think rage bait is toxic.
rage.zh: 所以，不难理解为什么许多人认为“愤怒诱饵”是有毒的。

rage.en: But now, a new trend called rage bait is spreading across social media.
rage.zh: 但现在，一种名为“愤怒诱饵”的新趋势正在社交媒体上蔓延。

rage.en: Show trials were held in the People’s Court, presided over by the raging, screaming judge Roland Freisler.
rage.zh: 公开审判在人民法院举行，由暴怒叫嚣的法官罗兰·弗莱斯勒（Roland Freisler）主持。

rage.en: Almost 100 years later, in the spiritual home of free-market capitalism, the debate about the minimum wage rages on.
rage.zh: 近 100 年后，在这个自由市场资本主义的精神家园，关于最低工资的辩论仍在激烈进行。

rage.en: Instead, the war raged on, and the failed coup of July 20th went down as one of history’s most haunting ‘what ifs’.
rage.zh: 然而，战火仍在继续，7月20日的未遂政变作为历史上最令人挥之不去的“如果”之一载入了史册。

radioactive.en: Later that same year, they discovered radium a substance far more radioactive than uranium.
radioactive.zh: 同年晚些时候，他们发现了镭（radium），这是一种放射性远超铀的物质。

radioactive.en: Pitchblende was radioactive, and Marie noticed that it was actually more radioactive than uranium.
radioactive.zh: 沥青铀矿具有放射性，玛丽注意到它的放射性实际上比铀还要强。

radioactive.en: Of course, spent nuclear fuel is dangerous, and it remains radioactive for thousands of years.
radioactive.zh: 当然，乏燃料是危险的，并且在数千年内都保持着放射性。

radioactive.en: The green tea contained polonium-210, a radioactive element, and three weeks later, after a drawn out and very public decline, he died.
radioactive.zh: 这杯绿茶里含有钋-210，这是一种放射性元素，三周后，在经历了一场漫长而广为人知的健康恶化后，他死了。

random.en: Focus on relevant vocabulary. Don’t try to memorize endless lists of random words.
random.zh: 专注于相关的词汇。不要试图去背诵无休止的随机单词列表。

random.en: Do you think that you could successfully have a conversation in English with a random stranger?
random.zh: 你觉得你能用英语和一个陌生人成功对话吗？

random.en: English is not random. It has patterns, structure, grammar rules, vocabulary systems, and pronunciation logic.
random.zh: 英语不是随机的。它有模式、结构、语法规则、词汇系统和发音逻辑。

random.en: Or rather, not literally pulled in off the street, but chosen at random from the electoral roll.
random.zh: 严格来说，倒也不是真的从街头拉来的，而是从选民名册中随机挑选出来的。

random.en: It would just generate random IELTS style writing prompts every day, and I made it using Claude.
random.zh: 它每天只会生成随机的雅思风格写作提示，而我是用Claude制作的。

ranch.en: He had grown up among ranching people and shared their wariness of the Earp brothers, who he saw as outsiders with their own agenda, which they were, really.
ranch.zh: 他从小在牧场人家中长大，和他们一样对 Earp 兄弟心存戒备，认为这几兄弟是心怀私利的外来者——事实也确实如此。

radical.en: Even more radical would be to remove permanent members entirely (which is very unlikely).
radical.zh: 更激进的做法是彻底取消常任理事国（这非常不可能）。

radical.en: One of the first and most radical changes was the abolition of the Caliphate in 1924.
radical.zh: 最初也是最激进的变革之一是1924年废除哈里发制度。

radical.en: Among its members is a more radical faction, led by a socialist named Ali Soilih.
radical.zh: 在其成员中，有一个由名叫 Ali Soilih 的社会主义者领导的更为激进的派系。

radical.en: This was a radical idea. It explained how new species could arise.
radical.zh: 这是一个激进的想法。它解释了新物种是如何产生的。

radical.en: Even though the idea had spread through much of Europe, it was still a radical idea in America.
radical.zh: 尽管这一理念已经传遍了欧洲大部分地区，但在美国仍然是一个激进的想法。

rainy.en: It's green, rainy, and incredibly beautiful.
rainy.zh: 那里绿草如茵，多雨，而且美得令人惊叹。

rainy.en: And there’s more. Water use might be a non-issue in the wet and rainy country of Scotland, but in countries less blessed by constant showers and flowing rivers, it is.
rainy.zh: 不仅如此。在湿润多雨的苏格兰，水资源利用可能不是个问题，但在那些没有经常下雨和流淌河流眷顾的国家里，它就是个问题。

rational.en: This was, by the standards of its time, a highly educated and rational society.
rational.zh: 按当时的标准，这是一个高度受教育且理性的社会。

rational.en: Can otherwise normal, rational people, be turned into monsters, if placed in particular circumstances?
rational.zh: 原本正常、理性的人，如果被置于特定的环境中，会不会变成怪物？

rational.en: He saw himself not as a madman, but as a rational revolutionary.
rational.zh: 他认为自己不是疯子，而是理性的革命者。

rational.en: Enlightenment thinkers argued that societies should be organized according to principles, rational principles, not just accepting traditions.
rational.zh: 启蒙思想家认为，社会的组织应该根据原则、理性原则，而不仅仅是接受传统。

rational.en: It was disturbingly rational. Logical. Eloquent.
rational.zh: 它令人不安地理性。逻辑严密。文笔流畅。

rag.en: So, he returns not in the clothes of a triumphant king, but disguised as a poor beggar clad in rags.
rag.zh: 因此，他回来时没有穿着凯旋国王的衣服，而是伪装成一个衣衫褴褛的穷乞丐。

raid.en: As air raids intensified, large parts of Berlin were destroyed.
raid.zh: 随着空袭的加剧，柏林的大片地区被摧毁。

raid.en: The winter was brutal, crops had failed, smallpox had swept through, and Indian raids from the north had left families grieving.
raid.zh: 冬天残酷无情，庄稼绝收，天花肆虐，北方的印第安人袭击更是让许多家庭陷入失去亲人的悲痛之中。

raid.en: Chinese rulers wanted protection against invasions and raids from groups living to the north, particularly the nomadic tribes that were living on the Mongolian Steppe.
raid.zh: 中国统治者希望防范来自北方群体的入侵和袭击，特别是生活在蒙古草原上的游牧部落。

raid.en: This siege involved 872 days of non-stop artillery and bombing raids in an attempt to annihilate, to completely destroy, the city and its 3 million residents.
raid.zh: 这场围城战包含了长达872天不间断的炮击和轰炸，企图彻底消灭、彻底摧毁这座城市及其300万居民。

raid.en: He didn’t want to go straight to the authorities; he knew his brother might be in a fragile mental state, and he didn’t want a raid resulting in him getting shot.
raid.zh: 他不想直接去找当局；他知道他哥哥的精神状态可能很脆弱，他不想因为突袭搜查而导致他被枪击。

rack.en: A data centre is, essentially, a giant warehouse full of computers, tens of thousands of them, all stacked up in metal racks, blinking away, processing and storing data.
rack.zh: 数据中心本质上是一个摆满计算机的巨大仓库，里面有几万台计算机，全都在金属架上层层叠叠地码好，一闪一闪地处理和存储数据。

rapid.en: And now with the rapid growth of artificial intelligence, we face an even more complex challenge.
rapid.zh: 现在，随着人工智能的飞速发展，我们面临着更加复杂的挑战。

rapid.en: Rapid economic growth over the past 30, 40, 50 years has changed China.
rapid.zh: 过去30、40、50年间的经济迅猛增长改变了中国。

rapid.en: Its rapid urbanization has led to overcrowding, traffic, and pollution.
rapid.zh: 其快速的城市化导致了拥挤、交通和污染。

rapid.en: As industrialization spread across Europe, Berlin experienced rapid population growth.
rapid.zh: 随着工业化在欧洲蔓延，柏林经历了人口的快速增长。

rapid.en: And the Mass Rapid Transport system provides efficient public transport.
rapid.zh: 而捷运系统则提供了高效的公共交通。

rabbit.en: If you spend too much time down internet rabbit holes, you’ll find accusations of the Freemasons’ involvement in historical events like the drafting of the U.S.
rabbit.zh: 如果你花太多时间泡在互联网的阴暗角落里，你会发现对共济会参与历史事件的种种指控，比如起草美国宪法。

rabbit.en: Happiness as a goal in itself might be more of a recent ideal, but it seems reasonable to suppose that even early hunter-gatherer communities tens of thousands of years ago would have pursued activities that would have brought them happiness, whether that was sitting around a fire and eating a roasted rabbit together, or painting animals on the walls of caves and telling stories to their children.
rabbit.zh: 把幸福本身当作一个目标可能是一个比较现代的理想，但可以合理推测，甚至在几万年前的早期狩猎采集社群中，人们也会追求能带给自己快乐的活动，不管是围坐在火堆旁一起吃烤兔子，还是在岩壁上画动物并给孩子们讲故事。

rating.en: Some polls pegged his approval rating as low as 30%.
rating.zh: 一些民意调查显示他的支持率低至 30%。

rating.en: As for buyers, they could scroll through the website, perusing different drugs, reading reviews and ratings, before deciding which one to go for.
rating.zh: 至于买家，他们可以浏览网站，仔细查看不同的毒品，阅读评论和评分，然后决定购买哪一种。

rally.en: But a Formula 1 driver or rally racer? They don’t stop.
rally.zh: 但 F1 车手或拉力赛车手呢？他们不会停下来。

rally.en: Israel’s allies rallied in support, and Israel proved victorious.
rally.zh: 以色列的盟友纷纷声援，最终以色列取得了胜利。

rally.en: While secularists and youth rallied in Tahrir Square with passion but little structure, the Brotherhood had members, money, and a plan.
rally.zh: 当世俗主义者和青年们带着激情却缺乏结构在解放广场集会时，兄弟会有成员、有资金、有计划。

rally.en: The Nazi regime used Berlin as a stage. It was the place where they held their mass rallies and their military parades, and also carefully controlled public events designed to project strength and unity.
rally.zh: 纳粹政权将柏林作为一个舞台。这是他们举行群众集会、阅兵式以及精心控制的旨在彰显力量和团结的公共活动的地方。

rainforest.en: Today most of the island is protected as national parkland and covered in rainforest.
rainforest.zh: 如今，该岛的大部分地区作为国家公园受到保护，并被雨林覆盖。

rainforest.en: Beyond the crabs, the island is rich in wildlife, coral reefs, and rainforests.
rainforest.zh: 除了螃蟹，这个岛还拥有丰富的野生动物、珊瑚礁和热带雨林。

rainforest.en: The city is in between mountains and tropical rainforests and the Atlantic Ocean.
rainforest.zh: 这座城市夹在山脉、热带雨林和大西洋之间。

rainforest.en: It is larger than a country like Austria, and most of French Guiana is covered by rainforest, the Amazon rainforest.
rainforest.zh: 它的面积比奥地利这样的国家还要大，法属圭亚那的大部分地区都被雨林所覆盖，也就是亚马逊雨林。

rainforest.en: It is larger than a country like Austria, and most of French Guiana is covered by rainforest, the Amazon rainforest.
rainforest.zh: 它的面积比奥地利这样的国家还要大，法属圭亚那的大部分地区都被雨林所覆盖，也就是亚马逊雨林。

ratio.en: But it’s not just in living things. Hurricane spirals, galaxies, and even the structure of DNA reflect this ratio, almost as if the universe itself is built on a foundation of mathematical elegance.
ratio.zh: 但这不仅存在于生物中。飓风螺旋、星系，甚至 DNA 的结构都反映了这个比例，几乎就像宇宙本身就是建立在数学优雅的基础之上一样。

ratio.en: Then there’s the so-called “Golden Ratio”, a number approximately equal to 1.618, which has been called the “perfect proportion” and has often been claimed to show up in everything from the spiral of a shell to the proportions of the human body.
ratio.zh: 然后是所谓的“黄金分割率”，一个约等于 1.618 的数字，被称为“完美比例”，人们经常声称它出现在从贝壳的螺旋到人体比例的万事万物中。

rat.en: Like the rat, if he has no option to escape, he will attack.
rat.zh: 就像老鼠一样，如果他没有逃跑的选择，他就会发起攻击。

rat.en: I was surprised and frightened. Now the rat was chasing me.
rat.zh: 我又惊又怕。这下变成老鼠在追我了。

railroad.en: There was a large battle between Thatcher and the coal miners, and eventually, after almost a year of strikes, Thatcher won, and then embarked on a series of privatisation measures, shutting down unprofitable mines and factories and selling off everything from railroads to utility companies to private investors.
railroad.zh: Thatcher 与煤矿工人展开了一场激烈的较量，最终在经历近一年的罢工后，Thatcher 获胜，随后推行了一系列私有化措施，关闭了亏损的矿山和工厂，并将从铁路到公用事业公司的所有资产出售给私人投资者。

racial.en: Singapore is majority Chinese. In 1964, racial riots broke out in Singapore between Malay and Chinese communities, resulting in deaths and injuries.
racial.zh: 新加坡是以华人为主的。1964年，新加坡爆发了马来族和华人社群之间的种族骚乱，导致了人员伤亡。

ramble.en: One common problem is rambling. Rambling questions.
ramble.zh: 常见的一个问题就是冗长啰嗦。也就是啰里啰嗦的问题。

ramble.en: One common problem is rambling. Rambling questions.
ramble.zh: 常见的一个问题就是冗长啰嗦。也就是啰里啰嗦的问题。

rail.en: Rail connections linked Berlin to other German and European cities as well.
rail.zh: 铁路连接也将柏林与其他德国和欧洲城市连接起来。

radioactivity.en: Radioactivity is the property by which certain substances spontaneously emit energy.
radioactivity.zh: 放射性是指某些物质自发释放能量的属性。

radioactivity.en: She discovered two new elements. She coined the term radioactivity.
radioactivity.zh: 她发现了两种新元素。她创造了“放射性”一词。

radium.en: Later that same year, they discovered radium a substance far more radioactive than uranium.
radium.zh: 同年晚些时候，他们发现了镭（radium），这是一种放射性远超铀的物质。

radium.en: To isolate radium Marie painstakingly processed massive amounts of a mineral known as pitchblende.
radium.zh: 为了分离出镭，玛丽辛苦地处理了大量被称为沥青铀矿的矿石。
